note: Per-industry feed configuration of the Giving Forecast ingest (OpenSecrets and IBISWorld). The ingest never edits this file or the refit registry: code verification results and calibration outcomes are written as proposed_registry_patch.json next to the run receipt, and the owner applies them.

opensecrets_frozen.note: The 63 recipient captures and the totals pages of these codes (taken 2026-09-27) are kept permanently as the frozen historical baseline. The feeds only add data (new industries, later cycles); they never overwrite, re-fetch or re-derive these captures.

permission.basis: owner states explicit permission from OpenSecrets
permission.recorded_by: ingest build of 2026-09-30, on the owner ruling relayed by the orchestrator; OpenSecrets' own grant was not seen by the builder

opensecrets_fetch.terms_note: The terms page is not fetched on each run: the owner holds OpenSecrets' explicit permission. Set terms_sha256_reviewed to a hash to make every run compare the live terms page against it.

opensecrets.scope_caveat: OpenSecrets assigns one primary category to each organisation, so a multi-line insurer coded to another category (for example generic Insurance, F09) is not in F3400; F3400 can undercount the property and casualty political footprint.

bulk_recipes.note: First recipe of FEEDS_SPEC 4.2: candidate recipients from individual gifts to N-prefixed recipients plus direct PAC gifts (DI = D); negative amounts (refunds) are kept. Not used for any number until fi_os_calibrate accepts it.
